Thanks — Fri 10:00am–10:30am works best for us.

A few quick answers to the checklist items:
- Sustained QPS: 90–130 reqs/s during business hours (they average ~100); bursts up to ~220 for short windows (1–2 minutes).
- Typical payload: 400–900 tokens in, 150–400 tokens out.
- 95th p99 latency target: aiming <150ms; 99.9th <500ms if possible.
- Region: us-west (we prefer low-latency to West Coast customers).
- Security: SOC2 required eventually; for the demo we can share non-prod telemetry.

I attached a small sample telemetry file to give an idea of QPS distribution. Let me know if you need anything else before Friday.

Ava —

Reviewed the sample. Short answer: we can meet p99 <150ms in us-west with the following conservative config for the spike test:
- Model runtime: optimized fp16 w/ kernel height tuning
- Baseline nodes: 2x A100-sim instances (reserved for demo), autoscale policy to add 1 extra node at 180 QPS
- Batching: target batch size tuned to 64 tokens average, dynamic batch timeout 25ms
- KV prefix caching for common prompts to reduce repeated compute for chat-like flows

I’ll join Friday’s call and can share a one-slide sizing summary. Ben — I confirmed the slot in HubSpot (deal RDW-2028-0341) and sent the calendar invite to Sara with the demo link. Attached: quick runbook notes I’ll reference on the call.

Marissa Cole
